metadata.summary: The BraTS 2024 challenge provides multi-parametric MRI (mpMRI) scans with corresponding ground truth annotations for brain tumor tasks across several sub-challenges: post-treatment glioma (≈2,200 patients), pre-treatment glioma (≈1,250 training cases from the training set plus additional), pediatric tumors (≈2,490), meningioma (≈650), brain metastases (≈460), and an Africa subset (≈750). The challenge also includes an unseen test set of over 4,000 patients and a histopathology extension with 280,000 tiles.
metadata.purpose: To support diverse tasks for brain tumor segmentation, survival prediction, and molecular marker classification.

papers.title: BraTS 2024: Diverse tasks for brain tumor segmentation, survival prediction, and molecular marker classification

known_limitations: Data collected from multiple international sites but without standardized acquisition protocols or harmonization.
Subgroup definitions (e.g., 'Africa subset') lack granular demographic or clinical metadata.
No reported age, sex, or ethnicity distributions limit assessment of representativeness.
Test set is unseen and unannotated — performance generalizability depends on domain shift robustness.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Over-representation of high-resource academic centers; Africa subset is small (≈750) and lacks detail on recruitment criteria or representativeness.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Brain metastases (≈460) and meningioma (≈650) are substantially smaller than pediatric (≈2,490) and post-treatment glioma (≈2,200) subsets.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Coverage defined by tumor type and geography (e.g., Africa subset), not by demographic or clinical subgroups such as age bands or molecular subtypes beyond specified markers.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: No information provided on extent or pattern of missing clinical or imaging data.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Data selected to cover diverse brain tumor types and clinical settings including post-treatment glioma, pre-treatment glioma, pediatric tumors, meningioma, brain metastases, and an Africa subset.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Multi-site clinical collection; stratified by tumor type and clinical context.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Aggregated from multiple international clinical sites; sub-challenges represent distinct clinical cohorts with independent curation.

population.target_population: Patients with brain tumors including glioma (pre- and post-treatment), pediatric brain tumors, meningioma, brain metastases, and African-origin cases.
population.missing_groups: No explicit reporting on underrepresented demographic groups beyond geographic emphasis on Africa subset; no details on sex, age, or ethnicity distribution provided.

annotation.labeling_provenance: Manual expert annotation of tumor sub-regions (e.g., enhancing tumor, necrotic core, peritumoral edema) on mpMRI scans.
